mapper.update: UPDATE collect_flow SET collect_flow_last_exec_time = #{begin}, collect_flow_exec_count = COALESCE(collect_flow_exec_count, 0) + 1 WHERE collect_flow_id = #{flowId}
UPDATE collect_flow SET collect_flow_running = CASE WHEN collect_flow_running > 0 THEN collect_flow_running - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE collect_flow_id = #{flowId}

UPDATE collect_flow SET collect_flow_running = ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM collect_task WHERE collect_task.collect_task_flow_id = collect_flow.collect_flow_id AND collect_task.collect_task_status = 'RUNNING' ) WHERE collect_flow_is_deleted = 0 AND ( COALESCE(collect_flow_running, 0) <> 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collect_task WHERE collect_task.collect_task_flow_id = collect_flow.collect_flow_id AND collect_task.collect_task_status = 'RUNNING' ) )
